newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank May fx reserves rise to $1.281 bln.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank May fx reserves rise to $1.281 bln.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Friday its foreign exchange reserves rose to $1.281 billion in May from $1.146 billion a month earlier.
"Central bank reserves less gold reserves stood at $1,281.493 million on May 30," a BNB statement said.
Reserves rose mainly due to net foreign currency purchases by the BNB last month, a BNB official told Reuters.

The BNB said that $402.555 million of reserves were held in current accounts and short-term deposits in first class foreign banks and $736.424 million in foreign securities and International Monetary Fund reserve position.
Another $101.663 million of reserves were held in precious metals deposited with foreign correspondent banks and $40.852 million were deposited with local commercial banks.
The statement said the BNB held monetary gold reserves of 32.074 tonnes, or about 1.031 million troyounces in its vaults at end-May, unchanged from April. BNB RESERVES, MAY APRIL MAY'96
